mapper.sql: select id, name, cover, parent_id, `order`, del_flag, enabled, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from px_wallpaper_folder
mapper.select: with recursive folder_tree as ( select id as root_id, id as sub_id from px_wallpaper_folder where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 union all select ft.root_id, f.id as sub_id from px_wallpaper_folder f inner join folder_tree ft on f.parent_id = ft.sub_id where f.del_flag = 0 and f.enabled = 1 ) select f.id, f.name, coalesce(nullif(f.cover, ''), (select coalesce(nullif(w.thumbnail, ''), w.url) from folder_tree ft2 inner join px_wallpaper w on ft2.sub_id = w.folder and w.del_flag = 0 where ft2.root_id = f.id order by isnull(w.`order`) || w.`order` = '', w.`order`, w.update_time desc limit 1)) as cover, f.parent_id, f.`order`, f.del_flag, f.enabled, f.version, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, coalesce(wps.cnt, 0) as wallpaper_count from px_wallpaper_folder f left join ( select root_id, count(*) as cnt from folder_tree ft inner join px_wallpaper w on ft.sub_id = w.folder and w.del_flag = 0 group by root_id ) wps on f.id = wps.root_id where f.id = #{id}
